value.rationale: The motivating source explicitly tabulates how many reciprocal divisor representations integers possess but its infinite power theorem establishes existence only. The general palindromic-shell lemma turns this natural finite multiplicity invariant into an exact count of a canonical infinite class, and the verified odd base 45045 yields an infinite odd family with at least N^0.30535 distinct representations. This is a structural quantitative theorem about representation growth, not an isolated small base count or a renamed corollary. Its limitation to lower bounds (not exact unrestricted counts) is stated.
